articles.title: FCRA: UN and International Agencies Excluded from Foreign Source
articles.summary: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) has been amended to exclude the United Nations, World Bank, IMF, and other international agencies from the definition of 'foreign source' under Section 2(1)(j)(ii). articles.title: Chinese scientists achieve record-breaking 24.0% efficieny for large-area perovskite solar modules
articles.summary: Chinese researchers achieved a certified 24.0% efficiency for an 810 cm² perovskite solar module and 22.0% for a 0.72 m² module using a new processing technique. The approach also improved durability, retaining 96% efficiency after 2,200 hours of testing. This breakthrough could impact global solar energy markets and India's renewable energy policies, given the country's focus on solar power expansion.
articles.raw_summary: Researchers achieved a certified 24.0% efficiency on an 810 cm² perovskite module and 22.0% on a 0.72 m² module by combining high-saturated-vapor-pressure (SVP) processing with lead carboxylate passivation. The approach also delivered strong durability, with modules retaining 96% of their initial efficiency after 2,200 hours of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) and meeting International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 61215 reliability requirements.
